name: genjiball-host-tool
description: Genji Ball Ranked host tool: watches the Workshop log folder and uploads ranked matches (Tauri)

scripts.icons: tauri icon app-icon.svg && node -e "for (const d of ['android', 'ios']) require('fs').rmSync('src-tauri/icons/' + d, { recursive: true })"
scripts.check:rust: cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run check:rust
